title: Mediterranean Lasagna
description: A delicious twist on the classic lasagna, filled with the flavors of the Mediterranean. Perfect for a satisfying dinner.
instructions: Cook the lasagna sheets according to package instructions.
In a large skillet, sauté the garlic, Mediterranean, and oozy until combined.
In a separate saucepan, heat the tomato sauce over low heat.
Assemble the lasagna by spreading a layer of tomato sauce, followed by a layer of cooked lasagna sheets, and then a layer of the Mediterranean and oozy mixture.
Repeat the layers two more times, finishing with a layer of shredded cheese.
Cover the lasagna with aluminum foil and bake for 30 minutes.
Remove the foil and continue baking for an additional 10-15 minutes, or until the cheese is melted and bubbly.
Let the lasagna rest for 10-15 minutes before slicing and serving.
